items.title: Hackers Got Inside a Flock Camera
items.title_zh: 黑客攻破 Flock 监控摄像头，发现硬编码凭证
items.title_en: Hackers Crack Open Flock Surveillance Cameras, Finding Hardcoded Credentials
items.summary: Wired reports and Hacker News discusses how researchers found Flock surveillance cameras riddled with security vulnerabilities, including hardcoded API keys and plaintext credentials, exposing flaws in the company's security posture and disclosure policy.

items.title: TMLR reached out to the authors of 10 papers slated for desk rejection, in an attempt to understand if the authors could explain the paper they submitted [D]
items.title_zh: TMLR约谈拟拒稿论文作者，多数人无法解释自己的论文
items.title_en: TMLR Quizzes Desk-Rejection Candidates; Most Authors Can't Explain Their Papers
items.summary: TMLR interviewed authors of 10 desk-rejection-candidate papers and found that most could not adequately explain their own work, raising serious concerns about authorship integrity and AI-generated submissions in ML publishing.

items.title: GoBench: Evaluating LLMs on the game of Go [R]
items.title_zh: GoBench：用9x9围棋对战KataGo来评测大模型的新基准
items.title_en: GoBench: A New LLM Benchmark Using 9x9 Go Against KataGo
items.summary: GoBench is a new benchmark that evaluates LLMs on 9x9 Go against KataGo opponents and finds strong correlation with ARC-AGI 2 while remaining unsaturated.
